abstract.para: Learn how to configure &minimalvm; images using automated &combustion; deployment.

topic.para: &sleminvm; comes with the &combustion; configuration tool, which configures the system on first boot from a script that you supply. This can be particularly useful when you need to deploy multiple virtual machines with an identical initial configuration. When &combustion; runs successfully, &jeosfirstboot; does not start. Because &minimalvm; does not configure a default &rootuser; password, the script must include a login method, either a &rootuser; password or an SSH public key for remote access.

step.para: Pass the script to the virtual machine. Use the method that matches your platform.

listitem.para: Pass the script file directly with fw_cfg.
Provide the script on a storage device with the file system label combustion, holding the script at combustion/script.
To build such a device as an ISO image:
listitem.screen: &prompt.user;mkdir -p iso_root/combustion &prompt.user;mv script iso_root/combustion/ &prompt.user;mkisofs -output combustion.iso -volid combustion -rational-rock iso_root
listitem.para: Create the virtual machine using your downloaded &minimalvm; image as the primary virtual hard disk. Before booting the virtual machine for the first time, attach combustion.iso as a virtual disc drive.

topic.para: By default, &combustion; produces no output while it runs. The indication that it worked is that &jeosfirstboot; does not start and you can log in as &rootuser; using the method you configured in the script.
